## Discoveries

[The Hills' Lookout](../world/discoveries.md#the-hills-lookout), [Above the Square](../world/discoveries.md#above-the-square), [The High Causeway](../world/discoveries.md#the-greenmarsh-causeway), [Where the Brook Meets the Sea](../world/discoveries.md#where-the-brook-meets-the-sea)

Regional mastery, earned by making discoveries here:

- **Local Knowledge** (2 discoveries): 300 mesos
- **Kaldemor Wayfarer** (3 discoveries): Skill: [Wayfarer's Gait](../skills/passives.md#wayfarers-gait)
